Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of discovery:
- Primary use case: low-latency retrieval-augmented generation for internal docs + customer-facing chat.
- Current pain: inconsistent latency on p95, expensive token spend when hitting peak query volumes, and limited ability to run in-private for regulated customers.
- Priority: Q3 pilot (proof-of-value) for a single product team, then expand to 2+ teams if results meet latency/cost targets.

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- Hosted API for quick POC, Dedicated pools for predictable throughput, or Private (VPC) for regulated workflows.
- Smart routing and prefix caching to cut token costs for repeated queries.
- Instrumentation and per-route dashboards to measure token spend and p95 latency.

Agreed next steps:
1) I’ll send our starter pricing + a short recording of the demo (attached).
2) You’ll share expected Q3 pilot scope (#users, queries/day, latency SLO) so we can recommend a config and run a capacity estimate.
3) If pilot looks good, we’ll put together a 30–60 day mutual action plan and propose a Dedicated sizing.

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf, discovery-recording-20260610.mp4 (link)

If it helps, I can block 30 minutes later this week to walk the pricing assumptions with you and Priya. Let me know what time works.
